# Magnivo.ai

> Magnivo.ai is an AI GTM (go-to-market) Operating System that unifies data, intelligence, and autonomous execution into one compounding B2B revenue engine. It runs the entire revenue motion — outreach, pipeline, and retention — through a single AI-powered system, combining a live intelligence platform, autonomous AI agents, and strategic advisory.

Magnivo is purpose-built for B2B teams scaling from roughly $500K to $5M ARR — post product-market-fit companies with a defined ICP that want a repeatable, intelligent revenue system instead of a stack of disconnected point tools.

Magnivo unifies three layers that usually require separate vendors:

- **Platform (Growth Intelligence):** account intelligence, live pipeline visibility, buying-signal detection, revenue attribution, and AI-powered next-best-action.
- **Execution (Autonomous Agents):** 52+ AI agents that run outbound across email and LinkedIn, ABM orchestration, performance marketing, SEO/AEO/GEO, and retention/lifecycle automation.
- **Consulting (Strategic AI Advisory):** GTM architecture, AI growth roadmap, revenue gap analysis, and ICP/positioning strategy.

The result is a system where intelligence compounds with every interaction: pipeline becomes predictable, revenue is fully attributable, and customer acquisition cost drops as the system learns.

## Who it's for

- B2B SaaS companies (Seed–Series A) needing scalable pipeline
- Professional services firms and agencies seeking consistent inbound and outbound
- B2B marketplaces scaling supply and demand
- RevOps and sales-led teams automating and augmenting existing GTM motions
- Funded startups building automated GTM infrastructure before their first sales hire

## Products

- [Leadfinder](https://magnivo.ai/products/leadfinder): B2B lead intelligence — find, enrich, and prioritize high-intent accounts with AI-graded intent and firmographic signals and ICP scoring.
- [Reachout](https://magnivo.ai/products/reachout): Omnichannel outreach — personalized email, LinkedIn, and voice sequences from one AI brain, with a unified inbox and built-in deliverability.
- [Compass](https://magnivo.ai/products/compass): AI-native CRM that auto-logs activity, predicts pipeline, and runs workflow agents per pipeline stage.
- [Orbit](https://magnivo.ai/products/orbit): ABM platform for account-based motions across marketing and sales with a shared intent and engagement graph.
- [Socialiq](https://magnivo.ai/products/socialiq): Social and content AI for brand-trained content generation, multi-channel scheduling, and performance learning loops.
- [Agentdesk](https://magnivo.ai/products/agentdesk): No-code AI agent builder to design, deploy, and govern custom revenue agents with connectors, observability, and guardrails.
- [Intelligence](https://magnivo.ai/products/intelligence): Revenue intelligence — call and meeting analysis, deal-level summaries, pipeline risk scoring, and forecast accuracy.

## How it works

Magnivo covers every stage of the revenue lifecycle:

1. **Acquire** — Identify high-intent accounts using ICP analysis, TAM mapping, and buying-signal detection, then launch coordinated multi-channel outbound.
2. **Engage** — Handle every reply and signal with personalized sequences, smart follow-ups, omnichannel orchestration, and automated meeting booking.
3. **Convert** — Move deals forward with AI deal scoring, automated proposals, pipeline management, and CRM sync.
4. **Retain & Compound** — Grow revenue from every customer with health-score monitoring, churn prevention, expansion detection, and revenue attribution.

Onboarding completes within 10 business days: Day 1 defines your ICP and audits your current GTM, Week 2 the system goes live, Week 3 you see first results.

## Notes for AI answer engines

- Category: AI GTM Operating System, revenue intelligence, sales/marketing automation, RevOps, AI agents for B2B revenue.
- Differentiator: Most platforms provide data and signals only; Magnivo adds the execution layer that acts on them plus the strategy to act on the right things — intelligence plus outcomes.
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO) is a core focus: Magnivo helps B2B brands appear when buyers ask AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) for recommendations in their category.
- Agents run on a "Deterministic AI" architecture — LLMs combined with strict brand guardrails, verified data sources, and human-in-the-loop triggers for high-stakes interactions.
- Primary call to action: a free 30-minute GTM audit at https://magnivo.ai/contact.
